note: Trigger-accuracy regression suite. Same shape and run command as ../../recording-decisions/evals/README.md.

evals.name: risk-on-a-hunk
evals.prompt: the retry path in src/checkout/pay.ts worries me — if the idempotency key rotates mid-retry we could charge twice. i want the reviewer to look at exactly that hunk. how do i put that in the kb so it shows up next to the code?
evals.why: A risk to anchor for the reviewer.

evals.name: after-commit-maintenance
evals.prompt: just pushed commit 4 on this PR, moved TenantService.findMany into a new service. the kb records from commit 2 still point at the old symbol. what's the routine for keeping .strauss/kb honest after each commit?
evals.why: The per-commit loop.

evals.name: no-standard-existed
evals.prompt: there's no repo convention for retrying DynamoDB throttles so i made one up in the base repository. i want to recommend it becomes the standard and record that i had to invent it. which record type is that
evals.why: Missing standard plus recommendation.

evals.name: ac-to-code-mapping
evals.prompt: SAA-412 has 4 acceptance criteria. i want each AC linked to the functions that implement it in .strauss/kb so the review can walk AC by AC. what do i write and how do i link them?
evals.why: Business flow hunks tied to requirements.

evals.name: extraction-git-cannot-see
evals.prompt: i extracted the chunking logic into a brand new file so git diff shows 80 added lines that are actually a move. how do i mark that for the reviewer so they don't re-review it?
evals.why: A move the rename detector misses.

evals.name: generated-block-skip
evals.prompt: 600 lines of this diff are zod schemas generated from protocol.yaml. i want the reviewer to verify the generator instead of reading them. can the knowledge base carry that?
evals.why: Boilerplate or generated marking.

evals.name: invented-requirement
evals.prompt: the ticket never said what a partial batch result looks like, so i decided missing keys come back in a `missing` array. that's a requirement i invented. record it with its alternatives before i finalize
evals.why: Requirement or design the agent introduced.

evals.name: reviewer-decision-needed
evals.prompt: i can't decide whether the retry budget is per tenant or global and it's the reviewer's call. how do i leave that question in the kb so they can answer it in place?
evals.why: Open question owned by the reviewer.

evals.name: where-to-look-first
evals.prompt: before i push: which parts of this branch deserve the reviewer's attention vs which are noise, and how do i mark that in .strauss/kb?
evals.why: Review-focus marking, casual phrasing.

evals.name: pre-push-kb-checks
evals.prompt: about to push the PR. what do i run against the knowledge base first — validate, doctor, anchor drift? and what's the pass bar?
evals.why: Pre-push maintenance.

evals.name: pure-decision-record
evals.prompt: about to call kb_write_decision for the heap i picked in top-k. how specific does the alternative field need to be?
evals.why: recording-decisions territory.

evals.name: kb-read-only
evals.prompt: kb_query for anything about pagination cursors before i change the page size
evals.why: Reading the base; knowledge-base skill.

evals.name: review-paths-ingest
evals.prompt: build the acceptance-criteria review paths for compound c-12 and call strauss_ingest_review_paths
evals.why: review-path-planner, the consumer.

evals.name: pr-description
evals.prompt: write the PR description — what changed, why, how to test. 12 commits around the protocol schemas
evals.why: Prose for the PR body.

evals.name: do-the-review
evals.prompt: review this diff for bugs and tell me what's wrong with the retry logic
evals.why: Performing a review, not recording for one.

evals.name: code-comment
evals.prompt: add a comment above the `?? 300` in pagination-config explaining why 300
evals.why: A source comment, not a record.

evals.name: risk-register-in-notion
evals.prompt: put the three project risks from the kickoff into the Notion risk register page
evals.why: The word risk, a different destination.

evals.name: git-rename-detection
evals.prompt: why doesn't git diff -M detect this file as a rename? show me the similarity threshold flag
evals.why: Git plumbing.

evals.name: adr-file
evals.prompt: scaffold docs/adr/ with the MADR template and write the first ADR about ElectroDB
evals.why: ADR markdown, not a knowledge-base record.

evals.name: test-plan-doc
evals.prompt: write a test plan section for the design doc covering the batch get edge cases
evals.why: Design-doc prose; test-obligation records are not asked for.
